facts.text: Middleburg Heights began in the early 1800s as a heavily wooded wilderness where log‑cabin pioneers first settled.
The town sits within the historic Connecticut Western Reserve, land ceded by Connecticut to the federal government in 1786.
The Middleburg Heights Historical Society has amassed a large collection of local history, including maps, photos, and newspaper articles.
That society’s mission is to involve and educate the community about the history of Middleburg Heights and Middleburgh Township.
Local historian Betsy Menzel has provided valuable information that helped shape the city’s historical record.
A walking tour of Woodvale Cemetery lets visitors hear the stories that the gravestones of Middleburg Heights’ early settlers tell.
